title: read-marker.json
description: Per-member read-position marker. Lives at read-markers/<alias>.json. See mad.council.a2a.md §7.6.

session_id.description: session_id of the owning member — reader-side spoofing check compares this against current channel.members registration.

last_read_seq.description: Highest channel_seq the member has observed. channel_seq - last_read_seq = unread count.

last_thread_read.description: Optional per-thread fine-grained markers for UI.
